user.description: Wake the Body Pod by tapping it, then pick it from the list.

person.title: First person
person.description: Add the first person who uses the scale. You can add more people afterwards from the integration page; weigh-ins are matched to people automatically by weight and body fat.

data_description.name: Used for this person's device and entity names.
data_description.birthdate: Type it in (you can type the year directly), or use the picker. Age is recalculated at every weigh-in.
data_description.activity: Sent to the scale with the profile.
data_description.expected_weight: Optional. Helps recognise this person's first weigh-in when several people share the scale.

abort.already_configured: This Body Pod is already configured.
abort.no_devices_found: No Body Pod found. Tap the scale to wake it, make sure a Bluetooth adapter or proxy is in range, and try again.
abort.not_supported: This Bluetooth device isn't a Hume Body Pod.
abort.not_connectable: A Body Pod was found, but only by a Bluetooth proxy or adapter that can't make connections. Enable active connections on your ESPHome Bluetooth proxy (bluetooth_proxy: active: true), or move an adapter that can connect within range.

error.invalid_birthdate: Enter a valid date of birth, e.g. 21/03/1974 or 1974-03-21.

init.title: Matching people to weigh-ins
init.description: A weigh-in goes to the person whose last weight and body fat it is closest to. If nobody is within the weight tolerance, or two people are too close to call, it is kept as an unassigned weigh-in for you to assign.

data_description.weight_tolerance: How far a weigh-in may be from a person's last weight and still count as them.
data_description.fat_tolerance: Typical body-fat change, in percentage points, between weigh-ins. Used to tell apart people of similar weight.

no_scanner.message: No connectable Bluetooth adapter or proxy is available to reach the Body Pod.

no_pending_weigh_in.message: There is no unassigned weigh-in on this scale.

person_not_on_scale.message: That person is not set up on this scale.

not_a_person.message: Choose a person's device, not the scale itself.

unknown_device.message: That device does not belong to the Hume Body Pod integration.

scale_not_loaded.message: The Body Pod integration for that device is not loaded.

assign_weigh_in.name: Assign weigh-in
assign_weigh_in.description: Records the scale's unassigned weigh-in against a person.

person.name: Person
person.description: The person's device. Their scale's unassigned weigh-in is assigned to them.

discard_weigh_in.name: Discard weigh-in
discard_weigh_in.description: Throws away the scale's unassigned weigh-in, for example a guest.
